title: Caerlum Rising Revisited
author: Mara Nakamura
blurb: Wendell Nakamura, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
